pretreatments.description: Hydrothermal pretreatment (HP) via autohydrolysis of sugarcane bagasse at 183 °C, 41 min, and liquid-to-solid ratio (LSR) of 3.94 mL g^−1, resulting in a weight loss of 29.5%, hemicellulose removal of 73%, and cellulose preservation of 82.1%, followed by alkaline extraction (AE) to partially delignify and remove low molar mass lignin fragments.

Advanced oxidative pretreatment (AOP) on alkaline-extracted pretreated sugarcane bagasse using varying ratios of hydrogen peroxide to alkaline extracted pretreated SB, liquid-to-solid ratio (LSR), and reaction time at 25 °C, optimizing conditions (0.3 g_H2O2 g_SB^−1, 9.67 mL g^−1 LSR, 8 h) to achieve high cellulose preservation (82.24%), enzymatic conversion (88.94%), and overall glucose yield (60.87%) while minimizing weight loss and water consumption.
